author: Obito0044
quote: Boring Story, Boring Characters, no funny humor like in gta5, mediocrely written dialogues, Jason is a horrible protagonist and pathetic. Jason's voice actor speaks like he has trouble opening his mouth and he forces his voice to be deep so hard. Very unauthentic. 30 fps and on base ps5 often dropping around 20 fps, too many unnecessary features, no good art style, short story, cars break to fast and too much realism. It destroys the fun of the game. There is no balance like in Rdr2. Game is woke. You play no gangster like Cj, Niko or Franklin instead relationship simulator 2026 where the man is a weak person. Very disappointing. Rockstar Games lost the plot after rdr2. We spend the last 8 years with no dlc for rdr2, no ps5 mode or 60 fps and they abandoned the bad online mode, overpriced rdr1 port on ps4/ps5 without multiplayer for 50$, gta definitive edition which had as many bugs as cyberpunk when it released. Ever since Dan Houser left everything went downhill
